latestVersion.changelog:
Photo Montage Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly turn up to 15 JPG vacation photos into a 1080p video montage with music and transitions
- Seamless workflow: upload images, describe the desired montage, and download an MP4 in 30–90 seconds
- Automatic session management and authentication with 100 free credits (valid 7 days)
- Supports multiple photo, video, and audio formats (JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4, MP3, etc.)
- Clear guidance on workflow, file size limits (200MB), and error handling for smooth user experience
